faqs.a:
Within 30 days of payment of the full amount owed to the city, the finance director
               or designee shall request that the city attorney prepare a release of municipal lien
               and the city clerk shall be notified that a release of lien shall be filed with the
               county clerk and recorder as soon as reasonably practicable.
(
Ord. No. 4042, § 1, 12-11-2006
)
